name: Harmony 650, Plasma kijken sends its input
description: todo-compile-650 2.5, 3.6 and half of 3.5, one write of lab/work/h650-bench-combined-2.bin: the combined bench file rebuilt with Logitech's input reset after power on, section 332. Start with nothing pressed since the write's restart, remote pointed at the Flirc. A side button is one of the buttons beside the screen, next to the corner whose label it chooses.

steps.instruction: More Activities, page to 3/3, press the side button beside Plasma kijken. Expect 'Starting Plasma kijken', then at the Flirc: Plasma PowerOn as seven frames in one burst, at least five seconds of silence, then Plasma InputHdmi1 as three frames, nothing else. Then the working screen titled 'Plasma kijken'
Press All Off. Expect Plasma PowerOff as seven frames, and nothing for any other device

More Activities, page to 3/3, press the side button beside Plasma kijken again. Expect the same as the first step: PowerOn as seven frames, at least five seconds of silence, then InputHdmi1 as three frames. This is the start that sent no input before the rebuild
Press All Off. Expect Plasma PowerOff as seven frames
Press Watch TV. Expect 'Starting Kijk TV' and the KPN power toggle and the Denon's PowerOn, nothing for Plasma. Then press All Off: the KPN toggle and the Denon's PowerOff
